name: Adaptive Marching Cubes
aliases: Adaptive Marching Cubes on Multiresolution Octree
definition: An extension of the Marching Cubes algorithm to handle isosurface rendering on Adaptive Resolution (AR) octree data, addressing inconsistencies between cells of different resolutions.
summary: Adaptive Marching Cubes extracts watertight isosurfaces from adaptive resolution octrees by resolving topological inconsistencies between differing resolution levels through a two-pass process.
